{{Legacy}} {{Infobox/Armor piece |title = Potato Crown |rarity = Legendary |speed = +1 |enchantable = Yes |reforgeable = Yes |auctionable = Yes |museum = yes |museum_xp = 0 |museum_category = special |id = POTATO_CROWN }} {{Quote |quotetext = All men can see the tactics whereby I conquer, but what none can see is the strategy out of which victory is evolved. |personquoted = Sun Tzu |quotesource = The Art of War }} {{See also|Potato War Silver Medal}} The '''Potato Crown''' is a special unique item awarded to the winner of the [[The Great Potato War|Great Potato War]], the late YouTuber "Technoblade", following his competition where he beat fellow YouTuber "im_a_squid_kid" in obtaining the #1 spot in the [[potato]] collection. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |rarity = legendary |type = Helmet |speed = 1 |item_ability_name = Potato King |item_ability_description = Bestowed by Hypixel to the winner of the Great Potato War.

{{Pink|''All men can see the tactics whereby I conquer, but what none can see is the strategy out of which victory is evolved.''}}
{{Dark Gray|- Sun Tzu, The Art of War}} }} == Trivia == * The item's quote is a reference to Technoblade's videos about the Potato WarSkyblock: The Great Potato War https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5qjnDd1rsIISkyblock: Potato War 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0PAEqgfAts4Skyblock: Potato War 3 (FINALE) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=09CeBwGbCeg, in which he quoted Sun Tzu's [[w:The Art of War|The Art of War]]. * The Potato Crown granting {{Green|+1}} {{Stat|spd}} could be a reference to Technoblade's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MmZ3zs76bZQ video] about him being the fastest man on SkyBlock. In the video, the reaction from the stat bonus the {{Item|Bat Talisman}} gave could be why it gives {{Green|+1}} {{stat|spd}}.
